title: Add tiered discounts to orders
description: Orders of 5 or more of one product get 5% off, and 10 or more get 10% off, rounded to the cent. The total is worked out in `src/lib/pricing.ts`. Includes tests and a README note.

comments.issue: The expected total is computed with `orderTotal`, the function under test, so the test only checks that the route calls it: a wrong tier, percentage or rounding in `orderTotal` still passes. Assert literal totals (999 x 5 = 4745, 999 x 10 = 8991).
